methods: DCC004 code paths unchanged except adding two registry entries: rans_native_estimated and rans_matched_estimated, with generator 1/2 and the identical selection=2 callback. DCC004 numeric identifiers retained internally.
block_sampling: For each frozen Silesia file and B, m=ceil(N/B); q=min(20,m); block_index_j=floor(j*(m-1)/(q-1)) for j=0..q-1 (index zero if q=1). Final partial block included when sampled. All offsets and hashes frozen before the DCC005 experiment. Groups of 20 blocks are nonoverlapping within one file/size, but different sizes overlap. These are sampled workloads, not full-corpus block encodings, and not 720 independent files.
block_semantics: Initial previous-byte context zero, fresh model/map/tables/state for EVERY block. No state/model sharing. Size is sum of codec bodies, all internal headers/padding/state included. No index, outer framing or stored fallback; secondary hypothetical outer-framed size=sum bodies+10 bytes per block. No deployable block container is implemented.

timing.order: xorshift32 Fisher-Yates of variant/phase tasks each round, seed 0xDCC00501 XOR frozen workload ordinal
timing.workload_operation: One complete encode/decode of every member with independent model reset. Blocks processed in sampled ordinal order. Bytes/time aggregate this group, not individual-block microbenchmarks.
timing.calibration: Double iterations from one until >=0.25 seconds, max 2^24. Keep below-target subsequent batches.
timing.input: Read/hash outside timer. All member buffers resident; warm-memory repeat.
timing.encode: Full statistics, clustering, selection, serialization, internal allocation/free. Prior encoded output freed before the next encode of that member. Retain outputs of final workload; release after timer.
timing.decode: Fresh table parsing/reconstruction and allocations every member; output buffers preallocated and touched before timer.
timing.verification: All return codes checked. All member outputs from final workload verified in full after ending timestamp.
timing.windows: QPC; main thread pinned to lowest allowed affinity bit. Power plan/settings captured around each timing job; no setting changes.
timing.summaries: Retain 11 raw batches, type-7 Q1/median/Q3. Throughput=sum bytes/sum member-workload median seconds, decimal MB/s. Do not pool DCC004/DCC005 speed samples.

memory: Separate allocator-instrumented executable; all 17 variants each member. Peak additional requested heap, excluding input/preallocated scratch, stack, statics, allocator overhead and total-process RAM. Encoder output included. Per-group sequential peak summarized as max member peak, NOT sum; not the benchmark harness retained-buffer peak.
resume: Whole-job checkpoints with file hashes. The launcher validates successful job files before reuse; interrupted/unvalidated attempts retained in separate attempt directories. New sessions capture environment; only same machine/compiler/plan/settings may reuse checkpoints. All attempts retained; no rerun-selection by score. DCC004 never rerun by this package.
limitations: DCC005 is confirmatory control and block-sample extension, not a newly unseen corpus (DCC004 Silesia whole-file results are known). No algorithm tuning, copyright transfer, GitHub upload, manuscript rewrite, gzip/xz rerun or worst-case approximate-selection guarantee. Canonical Calgary/Canterbury limitation remains.
